manifest.name: Home Inventory
manifest.description: Your belongings as their own room-by-room catalog: make/model + condition, filed by room. Scan to add, print labels for boxes, optional insurance valuation.
manifest.author: Cobblr
manifest.changelog: Three optional extras, each a checkbox: Scan to add (point your phone at a thing and it lands in the catalog with a photo and a name), Labels (print a QR label for a thing or a box on a Bluetooth label printer), and Starter rooms (Kitchen, Living room, Bedroom, Bathroom, Garage, Closet, ready on day one). Earlier: Rooms are now real Locations. The separate “Room” field is gone: items file into the workspace’s Location tree (rooms, and bins inside them) like everything else, so a thing has one place, not two. Your existing room values move over automatically on this update: each becomes a Location and its items are filed into it, nothing lost. The pinned “By room” view still groups your catalog by room (now off the real Location), and the claim-ready Insurance view too. Earlier: Home Inventory became its OWN table (an inventory instance) with only the fields a home catalog needs, plain-language hints, and optional Insurance valuation.

field_defs.name: condition
field_defs.help: Rough state, for resale or an insurance claim. New down to Poor.

features.name: Scan to add
features.question: Add things by pointing your phone at them?
features.description: Point your phone at a barcode or just the thing itself: it lands in your catalog with a photo and a name, filed in the room you are standing in.

next_steps.label: Scan your first thing
next_steps.hint: A barcode or a photo. It files itself into the room you pick.

features.name: Labels
features.question: Print QR labels for things and boxes?
features.description: One tap prints a QR label on a Bluetooth label printer, so a box says what is in it and a scan of the label opens the record.

features.name: Starter rooms
features.question: Start with the usual rooms?
features.description: Kitchen, Living room, Bedroom, Bathroom, Garage and Closet, ready to file into on day one. Rename or add rooms any time; nothing here is fixed.

features.name: Insurance valuation
features.question: Add insurance valuation (for a claim)?
features.description: Add replacement value + where/when you bought each item, plus an 'Insurance valuation' view to hand an insurer after a fire/theft/move.

next_steps.label: Value your items for insurance
next_steps.hint: Replacement value + where/when you bought each item.

field_defs.name: replacement_value
field_defs.help: What it'd cost to buy new today, what an insurer pays out (not what you paid).

field_defs.name: purchased_from
field_defs.help: Store or site, proof-of-purchase for a claim.
